keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Athletic Club 1, Getafe 0. Alex Berenguer (Athletic Club) from a free kick with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Substitution, Athletic Club. Beñat Gerenabarrena replaces Íñigo Ruiz de Galarreta because of an injury.
Goal! Athletic Club 2, Getafe 0. Iñaki Williams (Athletic Club) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Alex Berenguer.
Ramón Terrats (Getafe) is shown the yellow card.
Delay in match because of an injury Johan Mojica (Getafe).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Dani Carvajal (Getafe) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Athletic Club 2, Getafe 0.
Substitution, Getafe. Saba Sazonov replaces Francho Serrano.
Substitution, Getafe. Andrés García replaces Kiko Femenía.
Second Half begins Athletic Club 2, Getafe 0.
Johan Mojica (Getafe) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Athletic Club. Christian Imga replaces Nico Williams.
Substitution, Athletic Club. Alejandro Rego replaces Maroan Sannadi.
Goal! Athletic Club 3, Getafe 0. Aitor Paredes (Athletic Club) header from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Alex Berenguer with a cross following a corner.
Substitution, Getafe. Borja Mayoral replaces Ramón Terrats.
Substitution, Getafe. Enes Ünal replaces Iván Azón.
Substitution, Getafe. Davinchi replaces Johan Mojica because of an injury.
Beñat Gerenabarrena (Athletic Club) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Athletic Club. Beñat Prados replaces Peio Canales.
Substitution, Athletic Club. Txus Vizcay replaces Iñaki Williams.
Mario Martín (Getafe) is shown the red card.
Delay in match because of an injury Beñat Gerenabarrena (Athletic Club).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Athletic Club 4, Getafe 0. Yuri Berchiche (Athletic Club) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Alex Berenguer following a set piece situation.
